record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.original_question: Determine formal normal forms and complete formal-conjugacy invariants for superattracting germs of order 2 in End(C^n, O) when n≥3, and for superattracting germs of order 3 in End(C^2, O).

evidence.quote: (OP10) Classify with respect to formal conjugation the superattracting germs f ∈ End(C^n, O) of order 2 when n ≥ 3, or of order 3 when n = 2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{End}(\mathbb{C}^n, O)$ denote the set of germs at the origin of holomorphic self-maps $f:(\mathbb{C}^n, O) 	o (\mathbb{C}^n, O)$ fixing $O$. For such a germ, write its Taylor expansion at the origin as $f(z) = P_
u(z) + P_{
u+1}(z) + \cdots$, where each $P_k$ is a homogeneous polynomial map of degree $k$ and $P_
u 
ot\equiv 0$. The integer $
u = 
u(f) \geq 1$ is called the order of $f$ at $O$. The germ $f$ is said to be superattracting if $
u(f) \geq 2$, equivalently $df_O = 0$. Two germs $f, g \in \mathrm{End}(\mathbb{C}^n, O)$ are formally conjugate if there exists a formal invertible change of coordinates $\hat\varphi \in \widehat{\mathrm{Diff}}(\mathbb{C}^n, O)$ such that $\hat\varphi^{-1} \circ f \circ \hat\varphi = g$ as formal power series.

Solve the following two formal-classification problems:

(a) For every $n \geq 3$, determine an explicit list of formal normal forms and a complete set of formal-conjugacy invariants for superattracting germs $f \in \mathrm{End}(\mathbb{C}^n, O)$ of order $
u(f) = 2$.

(b) For $n = 2$, determine an explicit list of formal normal forms and a complete set of formal-conjugacy invariants for superattracting germs $f \in \mathrm{End}(\mathbb{C}^2, O)$ of order $
u(f) = 3$.
artifact.status_search_result: A search reveals partial progress on related questions (Böttcher-type coordinates for skew products in $\mathbb{C}^2$, formal Poincaré–Dulac renormalization for holomorphic germs, and normal forms for two-dimensional superattracting germs with nonvanishing quadratic terms), but no complete formal classification of superattracting germs of order 2 in $\mathbb{C}^n$ for $n \geq 3$, nor of order 3 in $\mathbb{C}^2$, was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Formal Poincaré-Dulac renormalization for holomorphic germs
status_evidence.snippet: Develops formal renormalization techniques for holomorphic germs but does not provide a complete classification in the indicated cases.
status_evidence.claim: Related formal-classification machinery exists, but does not resolve the stated cases.

status_evidence.title: Böttcher coordinates at superattracting fixed points of holomorphic skew products
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs Böttcher coordinates for skew-product superattracting germs in C^2.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results in dimension two for special classes; general formal classification not established.
